name: grantstack
description: GrantStack — a Claude Code plugin for big research-grant writing. Opinionated role-based slash commands that walk a major fellowship proposal (ERC, NWO Talent) from idea to interview. Sibling to MStack; inspired by gstack.

plugins.name: grantstack
plugins.description: A Claude Code plugin for big research-grant writing — 35 role-based slash commands across the full proposal lifecycle (frame, position, design, write, stress-test, submit, defend, reflect), a grant reference library (schemes, panel-report conventions, section-by-section bars, feasibility catalog), and hook-enforced edit safety.
